attack_techniques: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Unix Shell (T1059.004)
attackers_goals: Use the AppleScript interpreter to execute a second stage payload.
description: An uncommon shell script has been executed by the AppleScript interpreter process.
investigative_actions: Analyze both the AppleScript and executed shell script to determine whether they perform malicious actions. Check the events generated by the process or its children for potential malicious behavior. Check whether the script was executed in an unusual way.
